name: Email Assist
tagline: Weekday-morning inbox watcher that pings you only when it matters
description: On weekday mornings it reads through what arrived overnight and pings you about the messages that plausibly need you, leaving the rest of the pile alone. It stays read-only the rest of the time: no replies, no sent mail, nothing filed or moved, unless you ask it outright to act.
author: melvindvivas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
